candidates.change_summary: owner() returns msg.sender instead of the stored _owner, altering returned owner depending on caller.
owner() returns address(0) unconditionally, hiding the real owner.
owner() returns the contract's address instead of the stored _owner.
Require newOwner to be non-zero removed, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to zero even when newOwner is zero (changing behavior when called with address(0)).
Added an extra require preventing transfer to the current owner, causing transfers to same owner to revert and thus sometimes not change owner.
Tightened onlyOwner to check msg.sender equals owner() and also require owner() not zero, causing calls when owner is zero to revert (changing ability to call transferOwnership after renounce).
Removed owner check entirely from onlyOwner, allowing anyone to call transferOwnership and change the owner.
